description: This Java source file defines an Akka actor class 'OutboundMappingProcessorActor' that processes outbound signals within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It handles signal enrichment, filtering, mapping, and dispatching, as well as monitoring and error handling for connectivity messaging.

classes.name: OutboundMappingProcessorActor.OutboundSignalWithId
classes.description: A wrapper class that associates an outbound signal with its originating entity ID and sender ActorRef, including optional extra JSON data for enrichment.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates the Akka Props configuration for instantiate this actor with specified parameters.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the message handling behavior of the actor, including handling signals, acknowledgements, responses, and failures.

methods.name: handleNotExpectedAcknowledgement
methods.description: Handles acknowledgements received unexpectedly, logging and discarding them.

methods.name: mapDittoRuntimeException
methods.description: Maps a DittoRuntimeException to an ErrorResponse and handles it accordingly.

methods.name: mapMessage
methods.description: Maps incoming messages to the internal OutboundSignalWithId type, attaching the sender info.

methods.name: createSink
methods.description: Creates an Akka Stream Sink that processes outbound signals, performs enrichment, filtering, mapping, and forwards them.

methods.name: splitByTargetExtraFieldsFlow
methods.description: Flow that splits outbound signals into separate signals with/without extra fields based on their targets.

methods.name: enrichAndFilterSignal
methods.description: Enriches outbound signals with extra data if needed and filters based on filtered topics.

methods.name: recoverFromEnrichmentError
methods.description: Recovers from enrichment errors by logging and possibly reporting connection failures.

methods.name: logEnrichmentFailure
methods.description: Logs details of an enrichment failure.

methods.name: handleErrorResponse
methods.description: Handles error responses, logging, and mapping them back to signals.

methods.name: handleCommandResponse
methods.description: Processes command responses, handling success or failure and determining if further handling is needed.

methods.name: recordResponse
methods.description: Records metrics on whether responses are successful or failed.

methods.name: handleOutboundSignal
methods.description: Converts an outbound signal with id into an Akka Stream source for processing.

methods.name: forwardToPublisherActor
methods.description: Forwards the mapped signal to the publisher actor.

methods.name: handleSignal
methods.description: Handles signals (e.g., responses, errors) directly and wraps them in outbound signal form.

methods.name: mapToExternalMessage
methods.description: Maps an outbound signal with id to an Akka Stream source after mapping and monitoring.

methods.name: getMonitorsForDroppedSignal
methods.description: Retrieves connection monitors for dropped signals.

methods.name: getMonitorsForMappedSignal
methods.description: Retrieves connection monitors for successfully mapped signals.

methods.name: getMonitorsForOther
methods.description: Retrieves connection monitors for other signal events.

methods.name: getMonitorsForOutboundSignal
methods.description: Helper to get monitors based on target addresses and metrics.

methods.name: toMultiMappedOutboundSignal
methods.description: Converts a source of outbound signals into a single MultiMapped outbound signal.

methods.name: applyFilter
methods.description: Applies filtering criteria based on filtered topics and extra fields to outbound signals.
